value: Try the Pomodoro Technique: 25 minutes of deep work followed by a 5-minute break. Repeat 4 times, then take a longer break.
Deep work requires zero distractions. Turn off notifications and set a specific time block for your most challenging task.
If you're procrastinating, use the 5-minute rule: Tell yourself you'll only work on the task for 5 minutes. Often, getting started is the hardest part.
